title: ⭐ Pusha T - Blood Of The Lamb [V67]
description: Version with production from Dr. Dre and a verse from Pusha T, alongside added sound effects on the Dr. Donda West speech. It's unknown when this was made, but due to direct references from Pusha T to his mother's death in November 2021, and 2022, it was likely recorded in very late 2021, shortly after Pusha's mothers death as he was meant to have a session with Ye at Elon Musk's house the day his mother died. Has more production and sound effects in the intro. The song is most likely Pusha T's at this point, as it wouldn't make sense for the song to be on DONDA 2 due to it's sound, and other Donda throwaways were considered for It's Almost Dry such as "Hear Me Clearly" and "Dreamin of the Past".
